title: The Impact of CAR-T Cell Therapy on Fertility; A Patient Survey
official: The Impact of CAR-T Cell Therapy on Fertility; A Patient Survey
summary: As there is limited knowledge regarding the impact of CAR-T Cell therapy on fertility, LLS has designed a Patient Survey to learn more about the impact on fertility in patients who have received/are receiving CAR-T Cell treatment. The insights gained from this survey will inform future treatment protocols and fertility preservation strategies.
criteria:
* any cancer patient
* at least 18 years of age
* with a history of receiving CAR-T Cell treatment.

less than 18 years old.
